# File explorer panel

## Install

Add the fixed `0.1.1` npm release to the existing `plugins`
array in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{ "plugins": ["@daoninc/opencode-file-explorer@0.1.1"] }
```

Requires OpenCode V2. This is a TUI-only package; remove the equivalent local
entry when switching to npm. MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`.

Version `0.1.1` ships Solid-compiled JavaScript and helper type declarations, using
the `daoninc.file-explorer` runtime/command/panel namespace. Do not use the raw-TSX
`0.1.0` build with OpenCode 2.3.1. `/files` is unchanged.

## Features

Global OpenCode V2 TUI plugin. Run `/files`, or choose
**Open file explorer** from Ctrl+P. The panel follows the current session's
working directory and uses the connected server's filesystem, including for
remote sessions. It does not write or delete files.

The Files sidebar can open this panel directly at a selected file's preview.
Clicking a sidebar file or pressing Enter previews it; pressing **a** in either
view inserts its reference into the draft without submitting.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Up/Down, k/j | Move selection; scroll in preview |
| Enter | Expand/collapse folder or preview file |
| a | Insert selected/previewed file's `@path` reference into the prompt |
| / | Focus the search field |
| Down/Up, Tab, Enter (in search field) | Leave search field and navigate results |
| Right/l | Expand folder |
| Left/h, Backspace/b | Collapse folder, select parent, or leave preview |
| Page Up/Down, Ctrl+B/F | Scroll a page |
| Home/g, End/Shift+G | First/last entry or start/end of preview |
| . | Toggle hidden files |
| r | Refresh expanded folders |
| f | Toggle fullscreen (when terminal width permits) |
| Esc | Leave preview, or close panel |
| q | Close panel |

Click a folder to toggle it or a file to preview it. Use Ctrl+X, Right to
focus the panel and Ctrl+X, Left to return to the conversation. The host
automatically uses fullscreen on narrow terminals.

The search field recursively searches filenames and paths through the connected
server, not just expanded folders. Click it or press `/` to type. Results are
ranked by the server, show full relative paths, and are limited to 200 matches.
Search is debounced and stale requests are cancelled. Use Down or Enter to
return to navigation; file shortcuts do not intercept typing in the field.
Esc clears the search and restores the folder tree. The hidden-file toggle
also applies to results, subject to the server's search exclusions.

Select a file (or open its preview), then press **a** or click **Add to prompt**.
This inserts a textual `@path` reference at the prompt cursor, preserves your
existing draft, and closes the panel. It does not submit the prompt or create a
native attachment chip. The current TUI plugin API has no native attachment
method; use the prompt's `@` picker if you need an explicit file attachment.

Folders load on demand, sorted folders-first. Dotfiles are hidden initially;
ignored files and dependency folders are otherwise included, but not scanned
until expanded. Expanded folders refresh after relevant filesystem/session
events and every 10 seconds while mounted. File previews are read on demand,
display at most 64 KiB, and exclude binary files. The current generated client
rejects HTTP 206 partial responses, so previews fetch the full file without
Range; avoid previewing very large files over slow connections.
They are read-only plain text and do not auto-refresh. Symlink handling follows
the server filesystem API. Paths outside the session root are not browsed.

Run unit tests:

```sh
bun test
```
